component.name: Lavender
component.summary: Download synced LRC lyrics, online or from a local LRCLIB database

description.p: Lavender is a fork of LRCGET that can look lyrics up in a local copy of the LRCLIB database dump instead of, or before, the online LRCLIB API.
It scans your chosen directory for music files, finds matching synced lyrics, and saves them as LRC files next to your music or embeds them into the files.
With the lyrics source set to Online and the extra sources off, lyrics are looked up exactly as LRCGET looks them up.

ul.li: Removing a library folder keeps its scan, so adding it back is quick
Lyrics stay with their song after a full rescan or after music is removed
Switching to a different library folder no longer fails on a large library

description.p: First Lavender release, based on LRCGET 2.2.2.

ul.li: Look lyrics up offline in a local copy of the LRCLIB database, with tolerant matching and a content score that picks the best upload
Upgrade lyrics you already have, from plain to synced and from synced to word-synced, keeping the ones you edited
Optional extra sources: the AMLL TTML database, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music
A Lyrics edition setting that prefers uncensored lyrics for explicit songs
Mass downloads that pause, resume and survive a restart or a dropped connection
An opt-in update check that installs only signed releases
